scope: Human gate review of zero-based rows 95 through 189 inclusive of the capped Erdős resolved-theorem candidate queue.

nonacceptance.pending_reason: The cited fixed proof file proves the convergent-reciprocal variant, not the divergent-reciprocal base statement; only comment-level support was found.

method.statement_review: Compared every pinned natural-language block and exact formal type for polarity, quantifiers, domain, and scope.
method.status_review: Checked the pinned teorth status record for every row and the live numbered Erdős page during this review.
method.resolution_review: Retrieved the live problem bibliography/remarks and fixed MR, DOI, arXiv, PDF, gist, or git-commit evidence. Where a fixed formal proof was material, its theorem surface and sorry/axiom boundary were inspected.
method.importance_review: Required a nontrivial numbered-problem resolution or a separately sourced research theorem used in the resolution; explicitly easy/trivial support rows were rejected.
method.dedupe_review: Compared accepted statements within this slice and with the adjacent 0-94 slice; denied double credit to semantic equivalents and direct same-proof restatements. Problem 198 keeps base row 95 while explicit-witness row 94 is rejected in the adjacent review.
method.rights_review: Emitted metadata, hashes, locators, and original assessments only; no third-party paper text or source docstring is copied into the review.

scope_boundaries.row_156: Accepts only the explicit positive-upper-density formulation.
scope_boundaries.row_173: Accepts only the explicit [n/2,n] smooth-number variant, not a claim about unique historical intent.
scope_boundaries.row_186: Accepts only the displayed quantifier order: for every r, infinitely many n.

validation.authority_preimage_format: ASCII source_sha256, review_sha256, ordered_stage_claim_ids_sha256, and ordered_identity_payload_sha256_values_sha256 separated by one space and terminated by LF
